title: Brazilian farmers tokenized dairy cows to get loans, bypassing bank lending limits
summary: Smart collars monitor herd health in real time to prevent fraud, allowing local agricultural businesses to secure thousands in funding backed by livestock.

title: EU hits Russia with massive 21st sanctions package targeting $120B crypto network
summary: The EU is considering a ban on third-country crypto services providers for the first time and is targeting 14 crypto companies, which it has not named yet.

title: Crypto market maker B2C2 held sale talks with multiple potential buyers
summary: The SBI-owned crypto trading firm is said to have attracted takeover interest from a number of suitors over the past 18 months, but valuation has been a sticking point.

title: Crypto's institutional influx has killed the memecoin craze
A $5 billion cluster has formed in bitcoin options. It tells a bullish story
summary: Bitcoin's $70,000 and $72,000 call strikes on Deribit have accumulated nearly $5 billion in open interest, with calls outnumbering puts by a significant margin.
